collection.title: Aston Martin DBS Coupe 2007 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Aston Martin DBS 2007 - 2012 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
